thread:
miranda: Quick ping — PR #62107 updates the batching timeout heuristics and also reorders auth header precedence. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before merge. Targeting Mon 03/25 09:00 PT merge window. Link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/62107 :eyes:
omar: I can take runtime today. Can you paste the end-to-end perf numbers (p50/p99) and a short repro? :+1:
miranda: perf (local harness, 1k reqs): p50 21ms -> 19ms, p99 180ms -> 210ms. Repro: run ./scripts/bench --model gpt-small --seq 512. Patch summary: adds continuous-batching throttle and swaps auth header precedence in the request path. CLI snippet:
``
./scripts/bench --concurrency 16 --seq 512 --warmup 200 --iter 1000
```
sam: infra note — swapping auth header could change behavior for our sidecar proxy (env NAMED_PROXY_AUTH). Please add a migration note + an integration test in infra/proxy asserting header precedence; otherwise infra can't sign off for canary. :eyes:
tess: security question — does this change KMS access or add any new key usage patterns? Also add a brief threat-model note in the PR. If no KMS touch, we can do a light review.
miranda: no KMS changes, it's only reordering how we prefer X-User-Auth vs Authorization in the request handler. I added a one-liner in the PR description and a small unit test.
ci-bot: CI finished — all checks green except flaky-test/decoder-stream which is unrelated to this change. ✅ (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
omar: I looked at the harness numbers — p99 regressed at the tail under load. Can you try bumping the batch throttle from 8 -> 12 and rerun? If p99 comes down, I'll take owner review for runtime.
miranda: will try that and post results by EOD. If we can get p99 <= 200ms I'm OK with canary. Thanks!
sam: +1 for canary after infra integration test is added and passes.
tess: I'll do a light security review tomorrow morning.
miranda: awesome — leaving the PR in async review and tagging @oncall-runtime for merge window oversight. Thanks everyone!
